amendments.reason: The first configuration logs revealed that Nerfstudio defaults would auto-center and auto-scale poses, contradicting the preregistered raw-metric geometry outcome. The same logs revealed that the materializer included validation images in train_filenames, inflating nominal 25/50 budgets to 35/60 images.
changes: Set orientation_method=none, center_method=none, and auto_scale_poses=false for every confirmatory training run.
Keep validation frames present in transforms.json but disjoint from train_filenames; nominal budgets are now exact.
Rematerialize every random, pose-coverage, and trajectory-coverage dataset before training.
Use fresh v2 run names so canceled artifacts cannot be mistaken for confirmatory runs.
amendments.outcome_blinding: No model outcome or checkpoint metric was inspected. Modal batch ap-7D8UqePBwDMlLSxcIbkonA was terminated during configuration/image-cache initialization immediately after the issue was visible.

research_question: Does the frozen depth-gradient and pose-diversity acquisition policy improve sparse-view Gaussian neural mapping across independent camera trajectories, and does it outperform matched non-learned coverage controls when evaluated on leakage-resistant RGB, metric depth, and fused surface geometry outcomes?

hypotheses.h1_primary: At a 50-frame budget, the frozen active policy improves mean held-out PSNR and mean 5 cm surface F-score relative to matched random acquisition across trajectory and training-seed pairs.
hypotheses.h2_replication: The PSNR and 5 cm F-score effects are favorable on at least six of eight matched active-random pairs and on at least three of four trajectories after averaging the two training seeds within each trajectory.
hypotheses.h3_control: The frozen active policy has higher grand-mean PSNR and 5 cm F-score than both acquisition-time coverage and pose-coverage controls; controls are trained with seed 42 and are compared to the seed-42 active runs.
hypotheses.h4_uncertainty: The prespecified depth-gradient score has positive mean Spearman correlation with candidate-frame error and AUROC above 0.5 on at least six of eight seed models.

sampling.method: uniform over the full sequence including both endpoints
sampling.excluded_guard_frames: Up to 20; clipped at sequence boundaries. The frozen lr_kt1 split has 15 and the other three have 20.

acquisition_methods.random: The nested random 50-frame split from the same base split.
acquisition_methods.trajectory_coverage: Greedy farthest-first expansion in acquisition index from the exact 25-frame seed.
acquisition_methods.pose_coverage: Greedy farthest-first expansion in camera-center distance from the exact 25-frame seed.

training.pairing: Within each trajectory and training seed, random and active runs share the split, held-out frames, seed, iteration count, and hardware class. Coverage controls use seed 42.

pose_normalization.rationale: Preserve the published metric coordinate system for raw depth and surface evaluation.

training.validation_usage: Ten validation frames are disjoint from training and test frames and do not count toward the 25/50 training-image budgets.

secondary_geometry: precision, recall, and F-score at 0.10 m

geometry_evaluation.alignment: No post-hoc scale or rigid alignment; raw metric depth is fused with published camera poses.

analysis.unit_of_replication: trajectory-by-training-seed matched pair; pixels and frames are not treated as independent experimental replicates
analysis.active_random_summary: Report all eight paired deltas, trajectory means, grand mean, population standard deviation, sign counts, and a trajectory-cluster bootstrap interval. With four trajectories, intervals are descriptive rather than definitive inference.
analysis.control_summary: Compare seed-42 active, random, trajectory-coverage, and pose-coverage on all four trajectories. Report ranks and per-trajectory deltas, not only the best method.
analysis.negative_results: Report every prespecified outcome for every completed run, including metric disagreement, failed geometry, score diagnostics, and selector regressions.
analysis.missing_run_policy: Retry infrastructure failures without changing configuration. A training failure after two clean retries is recorded as missing with its logs; no replacement seed is introduced.

decision_rules.h1_primary_pass: Both grand-mean active-minus-random PSNR and grand-mean active-minus-random 5 cm F-score are greater than zero.
decision_rules.h2_replication_pass: Both co-primary outcomes are favorable in at least six of eight pairs and in at least three of four trajectory-level means.
decision_rules.h3_control_pass: Seed-42 active has higher grand-mean PSNR and 5 cm F-score than each of random, trajectory-coverage, and pose-coverage.
decision_rules.h4_uncertainty_pass: Mean depth-gradient Spearman is positive and depth-gradient AUROC exceeds 0.5 in at least six of eight seed models.
decision_rules.perceptual_safety_gate: Grand-mean active-minus-random LPIPS is no greater than 0.01 and no trajectory-mean LPIPS regression exceeds 0.02.
decision_rules.overall_support: H1, H2, H4, and the perceptual safety gate pass. H3 is a separate stronger selector-superiority claim and is reported whether it passes or fails.
decision_rules.failure: Any failed rule is reported as mixed or negative; no trajectory, seed, score, weight, threshold, or metric is changed after result inspection.

preparation_smoke.result_inspection: Data association and split counts only; no model was trained and no confirmatory outcome was observed.

stopping_rule: Complete the eight active-random matched pairs and four seed-42 coverage-control sets, evaluate all frozen outcomes, and write the complete record. Do not tune this experiment family after results. Further experiments require a new protocol and are labeled exploratory or confirmatory before execution.
